Check Sheet.name: Check Sheet
Check Sheet.description: Structured data collection across shifts and defect categories. Reveals tally counts that anchor downstream analysis.

Histogram.name: Histogram
Histogram.description: Frequency distribution of per-batch defect rates. Surfaces mean and spread.

Pareto Analysis.name: Pareto Analysis
Pareto Analysis.description: Ranks defect categories by frequency to surface the vital few that account for the bulk of defects.

Cause-and-Effect Diagram.name: Cause-and-Effect Diagram
Cause-and-Effect Diagram.description: Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram organising potential causes by category (man, machine, method, material, environment).

Scatter Diagram.name: Scatter Diagram
Scatter Diagram.description: Plot of one process variable against defect count to surface correlations.

Flowchart.name: Flowchart
Flowchart.description: Sequence map of the production / fulfilment process, useful for spotting missing or ambiguous steps.

Control Chart.name: Control Chart
Control Chart.description: Time-series chart of defect rates with UCL/LCL bounds at μ ± 3σ. Distinguishes special-cause from common-cause variation.
